title: Gift tax paid and donee basis — Rourke family
instructions: Martin Rourke gave land to his daughter in 2025. Compute the daughter's basis. Round to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.title: Gift facts
exhibits.content: Martin's basis: **$100,000**. FMV at the gift: **$400,000**. Annual exclusion: **$19,000**. Martin had used up his exclusion amount on earlier gifts and paid gift tax of **$60,000** on this gift.

rows.label: Basis increase for gift tax paid
Does the daughter's holding period include Martin's?
rows.explanation: With a carryover basis, the holding period tacks.

rows.label: If Martin dies within 3 years, is the $60,000 gift tax added to his gross estate?
